trial_court: Family Court, case number: MAT APP NO.126/2010
case_name: Mohin Saili And Sonali Singh vs Nil

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mohin Saili and Sonali Singh (husband and wife)

facts_of_case: The petitioners sought to challenge the Family Court's order dismissing their application for waiver of one year period for presenting a joint divorce petition under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act. The petitioners claimed that they were incompatible and could not live together, with the wife working in Qatar.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act cannot be allowed to invoke Section 14 seeking waiver of the statutory period of one year from separation.
legal_principles.held: d, therefore, for filing a petition under Section 13B of the Act, the parties cannot be allowed to invoke Section 14 seeking waiver of the statutory period of one year from separation.

legal_principles.principle: The court shall not entertain any petition for dissolution of a marriage by a decree of divorce unless one year has elapsed since the date of the marriage.
legal_principles.held: Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, it shall not be competent for any court to entertain any petition for dissolution of a marriage by a decree of divorce, unless at the date of the presentation of the petition one year has elapsed since the date of the marriage

outcome.final_order: The court allowed the appeal and granted exemption from the statutory requirement under Section 13B(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act.
